name: vault
description: Write work into an Obsidian vault from any repo: devlogs of coding sessions, finished D365 tasks, session handoff notes, quick captures, notes from the inbox or the web, and game collection cards. The vault layout comes from a JSON file in the vault, so any folder structure works.

vault_dir.title: Vault folder
vault_dir.description: Absolute path to the Obsidian vault on this machine, e.g. /home/me/vault or C:/Users/me/vault.

layout_file.title: Layout file
layout_file.description: Path of the vault layout JSON, relative to the vault folder.
